decisions.reason: Changing the displayed badge set and grid layout does not change the existing referral milestone conditions for awarding badges.
The badge presentation change does not alter NFT cover sizing or display behavior; the same message's sizing approval is already represented as execution evidence.
Badge count and layout do not change the rule that only successfully minted, wallet-owned NFTs appear on the dashboard.
The source changes the dashboard badge set and visual grid, while this candidate's current state concerns Small and Big Block ticket counters in NFT metadata.
The source does not revise the FAQ's description of badge award milestones or utility; a presentation count and row layout need not change that text.
Badge presentation has no effect on the deferred Transak fiat on-ramp provider, payment flow, or supported payment methods.
The badge count and grid layout do not alter the Small Block prize amount, winner count, eligibility, or sales trigger.
The requested four-by-four badge arrangement applies to the dashboard badge section, not the landing-page hero layout.
Badge presentation does not change public leaderboard authentication or the public statistics surfaces.
The badge presentation decision neither resumes nor otherwise changes the deferred Discord community server.
The badge set and grid layout do not alter mint price, revenue shares, or prize-pool funding.
The badge presentation change does not affect confirmation-email contents, certificate actions, or ebook access behavior.
